SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

Special Branch /Station/ File No. Date May 21, 1941.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY No. N. 863 21 5 41）

SUBJECT: Mrs. K.D. RIVKIN - Antecedents and character.

Mrs Klara Davidovna RIVKIN ( or Rifkin ),
Russian Jewess, widow, was born on 24-8-1883 at Odessa,
Russia. She is reported to have first arrived in Shang-
hai from the U.S.S.R. via Harbin in November, 1929. Here
she operated unlicensed boarding houses at 19-21-23 Sun
Avenue and later at 19-21 Seymour Road until November,
1935 when she left for Dairen. It is reported that she
was employed there first as manageress of the Jewish
Club and then as chief stewardess in the Dairen Club.

Returning to Shanghai in September, 1938 she
opened a small restaurant at 234 Broadway ( "Rose-Marie" ).
Having sold this restaurant she opened a similar business
at 21/3 Wayside Road in February, 1939 known as the "Won-
der Bar " and sold it in February, 1940. During the summer
1940 she is known to have operated a bar at 146/1 Quin-
san Gardens and a boarding house at 4 Astor Terrace. These
enterprises were liquidated some time towards the end of
1940, after which she removed to 1594 Bubbling Well Road
at which address she has since been operating a foreign
boarding house. She sub-lets five of the total of seven
rooms in the house. Her present tenants are: 2 members of
Italian naval personnel, two Russian females of no fixed
employment, both 21 years of age, and one Mrs Freda I.
Riffkin ( Rivkin ), also a Russian Jewess, aged 57.

While in Shanghai Mrs K.D. Rivkin did not come
to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with
any activities of an undesirable character.

Committee, Moulmein Road. It would appear from informa-

报告

特别支部 /分局/ 档案号 日期 1941年5月21日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部 登记处 编号 N. 863 21 5 41）

事由：K.D. RIVKIN 夫人 - 背景及品行。

克拉拉·达维多夫娜·里夫金（Klara Davidovna RIVKIN，或作 Rifkin）夫人，
俄罗斯犹太裔女性，寡妇，1883年8月24日出生于
俄罗斯敖德萨。据报她于1929年11月
从苏联经哈尔滨首次抵达上海。在此
期间，她在孙科路（Sun Avenue）19-21-23号经营无执照的寄宿公寓，
后在西摩路（Seymour Road）19-21号经营，直至1935年11月
前往大连。据报她在那里先受雇为犹太
俱乐部经理，随后担任大连俱乐部首席女服务员。

她于1938年9月返回上海，
在百老汇路（Broadway）234号开设了一家小餐馆（“Rose-Marie”）。
售出该餐馆后，她于1939年2月在威赛德路（Wayside Road）21/3号
开设了类似的营业场所，名为“Wonder Bar”，
并于1940年2月将其售出。1940年夏季，
已知她在秦山路（Quinsan Gardens）146/1号经营一家酒吧，
并在阿斯特台（Astor Terrace）4号经营一家寄宿公寓。这些
生意在1940年底前后某时结业，此后她搬至
静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）1594号，在该地址一直经营一家外侨
寄宿公寓。她将屋内总共七间房间中的五间转租。
目前的租客为：2名意大利海军人员，两名无固定
职业的俄罗斯女性，均为21岁，以及一位弗雷达·I·
里夫金（Freda I. Riffkin (Rivkin)）夫人，亦为俄罗斯犹太裔女性，57岁。

在上海期间，K.D. 里夫金夫人并未因任何
不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

她已在莫尔美路（Moulmein Road）的俄罗斯难民委员会登记。根据该委员会记录中的信息显
